# Areg SDK instructions

This file holds no content of its own. It used to carry a verbatim copy of
`docs/AREG_AI_CODING_RULES.md`, which describes how to change the areg framework -
not how to build an application with it - and so does not belong on the path an
agent reads by default.

**Read [`AGENTS.md`](../../AGENTS.md) in the repository root.** It routes every task
to the one page that answers it.

`AGENTS.md` covers one job: **building an application on top of areg**. Read it, then
the single row of its task table that matches your task, and nothing else.

Changing the areg framework itself is a different job. Start from
[`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../CONTRIBUTING.md); it names the two style documents that
bind code inside this repository.

Do not search the repository before reading `AGENTS.md`. It exists to stop exactly
that.
